description: This React component 'AntiCheatGuard' monitors user interactions such as tab visibility, idle state, and window focus/blur events. It renders a status bar indicating tab visibility and activity status, along with recent events. It also uses custom hooks to handle clipboard blocking, tab visibility, and idle detection.
